profile.design: Ex-post replay of reference accepted copies and purchase dates; five funded seats per original purchase; instant paid top-ups only when needed to prevent missed copies. Routed budget and physical seat cap are relaxed and reported, not asserted equal. Withdrawal settings stay fixed.

base_config.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.

capacity.interval_convention: [entry, exit); existing exits first; zero-duration offers enter then immediately exit
